name: stms
description: Student Task Manager — smart academic planning and productivity platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stms/shared && npm run build -w @stms/server && npm run build -w @stms/client
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @stms/shared && npm run build -w @stms/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @stms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @stms/server && npm run typecheck -w @stms/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @stms/shared && npm run test -w @stms/server && npm run test -w @stms/client
